Appendix 7: Capability assessment question set for Oil Spill Response Organisations
Use this question set to assess an Oil Spill Response Organisation's (OSRO's) capability against the Maritime and Coastguard Agency (MCA) standard. It provides a standardised scoring framework for accreditation bodies to evaluate oil spill response capability.
This question set supports the accreditation process for oil spill response organisations (OSROs). It enables accreditation bodies to carry out a consistent, scored assessment of an organisation’s oil spill response capability against the MCA Standard.
Accreditation bodies may use different assessment methods to gather evidence, including document reviews, online assessments, interviews, exercises or observations. The question set provides a standard framework to help ensure assessments are carried out consistently.
Who this is for
This guidance is for:
- accreditation bodies responsible for assessing OSROs against the MCA standard
- OSROs preparing for accreditation or reassessment
- organisations seeking to understand the assessment criteria used during accreditation
